posteriores.texto: A pé, Sísera escapou para a tenda de Jael. Jael era a mulher do queneu Héber. Foi para lá porque a casa de Héber mantinha relações de paz com Jabim, rei de Hazor.
Jael saiu ao encontro de Sísera e lhe disse: “Entre, meu senhor; entre aqui. Não tenha medo.” Ele entrou na tenda, e ela o cobriu com uma manta.

kjv.texto: But Barak pursued after the chariots, and after the host, unto Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword; and there was not a man left.

vizinhos.15: And the Lord discomfited Sisera, and all his chariots, and all his host, with the edge of the sword before Barak; so that Sisera lighted down off his chariot, and fled away on his feet.
vizinhos.17: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite: for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
